evidence: Read-only discovery on 2026-09-29 (scripts/signup-selectors.ts, session arm — windowed Chrome) and a page check the same day confirming an account signup, not a mailing list: easyJet's MyEasyJet Register page ('Your easyJet.com log in', 'Your account details'). Nothing was typed or submitted. A driven attempt through the proxy the same day (tunnel egress from a US address): every field took a vault token; the first two submits were refused client-side on the password (see gotchas) and the third, with a 20-character letters-and-digits password, left the form for a page carrying a checkbox reCAPTCHA and a sign-in heading, with no welcome text, no error and no emailed code. No welcome or activation mail reached the registered mailbox within 20 minutes. The sign-in paths under /en/secure/ then answered an Akamai "Access Denied" page from the same address, so the account could not be tested by signing in. Whether the account exists is undetermined.
gotchas: The email is asked twice (#EmailAddressCheck), which no field in this recipe covers: type the same address there.
The form also requires a title, address and a preferred departure airport; they are the account owner's to supply.
A session-timeout dialog (Yes / No) may appear on a slow fill.

Password: at most 20 characters, letters and digits only. The vault's default 24-character password with symbols is refused client-side, with the error under #Password naming the length cap, special characters and spaces. Pass maxLength 20 and noSymbols to create_login, or rotate the password before filling.
Filling #EmailAddressCheck: a second fill_login call carrying only the username half, with the same email token.

Selectors for the required fields beyond this recipe's: a title select (select[id*="Title" i], five options, none neutral), #Address1, #City, #PostalCode, the country of residence select #Country (defaults to United Kingdom) and a mobile phone #MobilePhone with its dialling-code select select[id*="Mobile" i] (defaults to United Kingdom +44). The country and dialling-code selects did not take the address and phone country tokens; selecting the option label ("United States", "United States(+1)") works. #Address2 and three preferred-airport selects (select[id*="Airport" i]) are present; the airports were left unset and drew no validation error.
The submit control is a plain "Register now" button, not button[type="submit"]; click it by its snapshot ref or by text.
The 20-minute inactivity dialog (#sessionTimeoutDialog_yesButton) sits off-screen and cannot be clicked; the form survived it here.

After a submit the page can come back with a checkbox reCAPTCHA and a sign-in heading rather than a welcome. That is a challenge for the owner to hand off, and it can arrive without any mail being sent.

The sign-in paths (/en/secure/MyEasyJet.mvc and /Login) answered an Akamai Access Denied page from a US VPN address on 2026-09-29 while the Register page loaded fine, so a post-signup sign-in test may be walled by egress.
